title: Baby Tracker for iPhone: Feeding & Diapers – Milksy
description: Track your baby’s feeds, diapers and daily activity with Milksy for iPhone and iPad. Keep a clear timeline, review trends and share the log with your partner.
heading: Baby feeding & diaper tracker
lead: Without the fuss. Milksy keeps feeds, diapers, and the little things in between in one simple baby log.
fact: See your baby’s day in a clear timeline, look back at everyday patterns, and share the log with your partner. Also available on iPad.
compatibility: For iPhone & iPad · iOS 26.5 or later

privacyText: Records are saved on your device. Family sharing uses iCloud and Apple CloudKit. Read how it works and find the app’s published privacy policy.
faqHeading:
A few things
you might wonder.
faq1a: Milksy is an iPhone baby tracker for recording breastfeeding, bottle feeds and diaper changes. It brings daily activity into a chronological Today feed and shows trends from your logs.
faq2a: Milksy records breastfeeding, bottle feeds, wet, dirty and dry diapers, sleep, pumping, and medication or vitamins. The website focuses on feeding, diapers and sharing.
faq3a: Yes. Milksy can synchronize a baby’s activity between parents using Apple CloudKit. The family owner invites their partner from the app’s Family settings. Both parents need iCloud for sharing.
faq4a: Milksy is an Apple app, with an interface designed for iPhone and iPad. There is no Android version. The App Store listing requires iOS 26.5 or iPadOS 26.5 or later.
faq5q: Does Milksy tell me when to feed my baby?
faq5a: Milksy helps you look back at logged feeds and familiar intervals. Its rhythm cards describe recent records; they are not predictions or medical guidance.
